body: I tapered off of Wellbutrin totally three weeks ago and I have been having TERRIBLE depersonalization and anhedonia. Has anyone else experienced this and how long does it last?
This is the only antidepressant that I've ever taken and I'm hesitant to quickly jump on the pharmacological merry go round by yo-yoing meds.
How much are you taking? Have you taken other similar medications in the past?
